name: How do I choose the right contractor for an infinity-edge pool project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an infinity-edge pool project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for an infinity-edge pool requires careful consideration. Look for firms with proven experience specifically in vanishing edge construction, as it demands specialized engineering and precision. Verify their licensing, insurance, and ask for a portfolio showcasing similar high-end projects, ideally with references. Evaluate their design capabilities, understanding of local permitting, and communication style. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed proposal, transparent pricing, and demonstrate a strong commitment to quality craftsmanship and client satisfaction throughout the entire process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with proven experience in infinity-edge construction, verifying licensing and insurance, reviewing their portfolio, and ensuring strong communication and a commitment to quality.
